summary_en: This study tests SMS001, a new form of the drug paclitaxel, in people with non-small cell lung cancer. SMS001 is given once, during scheduled lung cancer surgery, and the dose is raised in steps until a pre-defined suitable dose is reached. The main outcome is not stated; the study is Phase 2 and aims to find a safe dose and see how well SMS001 works.
summary_es: Este estudio prueba SMS001, una nueva forma del medicamento paclitaxel, en personas con cáncer de pulmón de células no pequeñas. SMS001 se administra una sola vez, durante la cirugía programada de cáncer de pulmón, y la dosis aumenta por etapas hasta llegar a una dosis predefinida adecuada. El resultado principal no se indica; el estudio es de Fase 2 y busca encontrar una dosis segura y ver qué tan bien funciona SMS001.
who_for: Confirmed non-small cell lung cancer by tissue exam
Stage Ia to IIIa (N2) per AJCC 8th edition
Age 18 or older and suitable for lung cancer surgery
No prior chemotherapy or chest radiation
Surgeon judges complete surgical removal of the cancer is possible
not_for: Locally advanced T3 or T4 lung cancer or distant spread
Need for pneumonectomy or sleeve resection
Cancer diagnosed within the last 5 years, except non-melanoma skin cancer
Pregnant or nursing, or known sensitivity to study agent components
